name: Shadumbra's Head
summary: At Splintertree Post, Shadumbra's Head is proof that a feared predator has fallen. Bringing it to Senani Thunderheart completes a trial of the Ashenvale Hunt and helps secure the western roads toward the Zoram Strand.

sections.title: A Menace of the Western Road
sections.body: Shadumbra hunted the woods west of Splintertree Post, where Horde scouts and couriers traveled toward the Zoram Strand. Her speed and stealth made those paths perilous, and each westward patrol kept the post's defenders wary.

sections.title: Proof of the Hunt
sections.body: Senani Thunderheart, a tauren huntress, challenges Horde champions to track and fell Ashenvale's great beasts as part of the Ashenvale Hunt. Shadumbra's head proves the hunter has brought down one of Kalimdor's deadliest native stalkers, and that travelers can use the roads with less danger.

faq.answer: Shadumbra was a savage nightsaber that prowled the forests west of Splintertree Post. She ambushed travelers heading toward the coast and was counted among Ashenvale's most dangerous local beasts.

faq.q: Why does Senani Thunderheart want the head?
faq.answer: Senani Thunderheart oversees the Ashenvale Hunt at Splintertree Post. The head honors a difficult hunt and confirms that westward travelers are no longer threatened by Shadumbra.

faq.q: Where does this fit into the Ashenvale Hunt?
faq.answer: Shadumbra's hunt is one of the primary trials of the Ashenvale Hunt. Slaying her alongside other great forest beasts such as Ursangous and Sharptalon leads to final recognition and The Hunt Completed.

faq.q: Why is clearing this beast important to the Horde?
faq.answer: Scouts and runners travel west from Splintertree Post to the Horde encampment at Zoram'gar Outpost on the Zoram Strand. Shadumbra threatened those on foot as they crossed the untamed woods.
Shadumbra prowls the woodlands west of Splintertree Post, among the trees between the road and the ancient night elf ruins scattered through central and western Ashenvale.

faq.q: Is Shadumbra allied with the night elves?
faq.answer: No. Shadumbra is a wild, feral nightsaber that threatens any who cross her territory. Though night elves often tame and revere nightsabers, she acts on predatory instinct.

angles.text: As a tauren, you honor the Earth Mother's natural order by testing your skill against an apex predator and protecting your tribal brothers on the road.
As a hunter, you test your marksmanship, patience, and woodland survival when you track an elusive nightsaber like Shadumbra.
As a member of the Horde, you help keep the supply lines from isolated Splintertree Post open to the Zoram Strand by removing threats like Shadumbra.
